title.zh: 【Strive 上周增持 4045 枚 BTC，累计持仓达 36,818 枚】
title.en: 【Strive 上周增持 4045 枚 BTC，累计持仓达 36,818 枚】

current_state.zh: Strive reported buying 4,045 BTC at an average of about $82,803, raising its total Bitcoin holdings to 36,818 BTC, while also completing a warrant exercise and pricing a $700 million perpetual preferred stock offering.
